title: Introduce credential concierge, compact stream facade, and cross-SDK parity fixes (py/ts/go)
text:
Introduce credential concierge, compact stream facade, and cross-SDK parity fixes (py/ts/go)

description:
Context and motivation: customer teams reported a set of interrelated SDK ergonomics problems when long-running streams encounter credential rotations and transient infra errors: (1) duplicate reauth attempts from parallel consumers, (2) inconsistent cursor/resume behavior between Python/TS/Go, and (3) differing retry presets that made service-level parity testing brittle. This PR introduces a small cross-SDK surface called the 'credential concierge' (a thin, opinionated orchestrator for credential lookups + telemetry) plus a compact stream facade that normalizes resume semantics and reduces boilerplate for application code. Work completed: - Implement credential concierge in each SDK (Python/TS/Go) with a consistent public API and pluggable provider chain. - Add adaptive retry profiles (idle-window, short-burst, long-tail) and ensure the same defaults across SDKs. - Replace low-level stream consumer helpers with a compact pull-stream facade that exposes a stable async iterator/async generator contract and a lightweight resume token. - Fix edge-case race where token refresh and stream reconnect could cause duplicate request bodies to be replayed. - Add end-to-end parity tests (matrix py/ts/go) and update docs + changelogs. Checklist: [x] API design doc reviewed (ENG-4521) [x] All unit + e2e tests added [x] Docs updated and sample snippets included [x] Version bumps applied to packaging and changelogs Notes: description intentionally concise; implementation keeps runtime allocations minimal and avoids cross-process state.

release_notes:
Adds a lightweight 'credential concierge' abstraction that centralizes credential lookup/fallback and telemetry across SDKs; introduces a compact, ergonomic stream facade (pull-stream friendly) with improved resume semantics; fixes cross-language parity issues around stream cursor iteration and token-refresh races; bumps Python/TS/Go SDK minor versions.

review_comments:
Evan Li: Overall looks good. Two asks: add a short timeout for concierge lookups to prevent blocking in sync clients, and please add a note about observability keys emitted.
Maya Thompson: Added timeouts to the concierge client and emitted 'concierge.lookup' span attributes. PTAL.
Priya Desai: TS lint flagged an unused import in compactFacade; also the iterator close path needs to ensure KV cache is released.
Maya Thompson: Fixed tslint import, added explicit close() on facade and ensured KV cache release in all codepaths. Added unit that simulates abrupt consumer cancel.
Carlos Mendez: Tests look good. One behavior question: when the concierge falls back to the local provider, do we still emit the same telemetry? We should mark source=local in the event.
Maya Thompson: Good catch — added 'credential.source' tag (local|remote|fallback) to telemetry and updated docs.
Priya Desai: CI flake on e2e matrix previously; re-run passes now. Approving pending squash commit message clean-up.
Evan Li: Approve. Recommend mention in release notes about migration steps for advanced custom credential providers.
